    @pytest.mark.priority(8)
    @pytest.mark.description("Test case for validating form submission from coach portal")
    @allure.title(f"Given HabiPersona form triggered, When user Login to user portal, Then user should be able to see HabiPersona form in the first order and unless its submitted, other forms should not be visible and can't interact with the app")
    def test_validate_triggeredHabiPersonaForm_from_userPortal(self):
        _, auth_token = self.createSession(config.get_login_credentials()['FORMTEST_USERNAME'], config.get_login_credentials()['FORMTEST_PASSWORD'])
        assert auth_token is not None, "Failed to create session"
        print("Auth token received:", auth_token)
    
        chrome_options = Options()
        chrome_options.add_argument("--headless=new")         # new headless mode
        chrome_options.add_argument("--window-size=1920,1080")
        # chrome_options.add_argument("--start-maximized")
        chrome_options.add_argument("--disable-dev-shm-usage")
        chrome_options.add_argument("--no-sandbox")
        self.__class__.driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=chrome_options)
        self.driver = self.__class__.driver
        self.driver.get(os.getenv('web_url', config.get_web_url()))
        self.driver.execute_script("localStorage.setItem(arguments[0], arguments[1]);", "token", auth_token)
        self.driver.refresh()
        self.driver.get(os.getenv('web_url', config.get_web_url()) + "app/dashboard")
        self.driver.set_window_size(1920, 1080)
        self.driver.find_element("xpath", "//a[text()='Accept']").click()
        self.__class__.wait = WebDriverWait(self.driver, 10)
        wait = self.__class__.wait
        os.makedirs("debug_artifacts/screenshots", exist_ok=True)
        self.driver.save_screenshot("debug_artifacts/screenshots/before_finding2_element.png")
        #as per the order, habi persona form should come first
        time.sleep(5)

        >>> from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
        >>> from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
    
        # Wait until an element is visible on the page
        >>> wait = WebDriverWait(driver, 10)
        >>> element = wait.until(EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.ID, "exampleId")))
        >>> print(element.text)

        stacktrace = None
